node.title: Re^3: Network File read not working if invoked externally
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:

@wslfiles[0]='\\\\XXXXXXX\\f\$\\apps\\webapps\\auth.wsl'; my @wsl = @{$_[0]}; foreach $filename(@wsl)
